articles.summary: Probably Genetic has been awarded up to $10 million from ARPA-H to help end the diagnostic odyssey for people with rare diseases. CEO Lukas Lange explains why comprehensive, patient-reported data (not AI alone) is what makes faster diagnosis possible.
articles.title: The End of the Diagnostic Odyssey Starts With Data

articles.summary: Probably Genetic offers truly no-cost genetic testing for eligible patients with rare diseases. Backed by research partnerships, the program eliminates surprise medical bills and insurance hassles. This guide explains how the free testing works, what data is collected (and what isn't), and how patients can apply in five simple steps—all with full price transparency and a mission to end the diagnostic odyssey.
articles.title: Genetic Testing Pricing Transparency
